locator: I q.3 a.4 co., first proof: illud cuius esse est aliud ab essentia sua
interpretation: The direction is actual being with distinct esse/essence implies an actually existing efficient cause at esse from another being, as a source inference from the explicitly stated causal dichotomy and no-self-causation principles. The converse and the inverse claim that essence=esse excludes every external cause are not asserted. The application invokes God as first efficient cause; it does not define first cause by essence=esse or establish the two underlying premises outside Aquinas' argument.
